hits.snippet: [](https://www.grocerybusiness.ca/stats/?sid=5&bsa_pro_id=142&bsa_pro_url=1) August 5, 2026 [People News](https://www.grocerybusiness.ca/category/people-news/ "View all posts in People News") Former Haleon president, Rupa Bahri, joins Foundation Consumer Healthcare as CEO # Former Haleon president, Rupa Bahri, joins Foundation Consumer Healthcare as CEO Rupa Bahri has been appointed CEO of Foundation Consumer Healthcare (FCH). She brings more than two decades of global health care leadership, most recently, as the seven-year Canadian president of Haleon, home to brands such as Advil, Centrum, and Sensodyne. She previously led major U.S. portfolio turnarounds at Novartis Consumer and GSK Consumer Healthcare. She began her career in R&D engineering at Medtronic before honing her strategic expertise at McKinsey & Company. She succeeds Greg Bradley, who co-founded FCH and has led it as CEO since its inception in 2014. He will transition to chairman of the board.
